statement.zh: 教科文将查科文化列入世界遗产，强调大屋、道路与礼仪景观（UNESCO 353）。
statement.en: UNESCO lists Chaco Culture as World Heritage, emphasizing great houses, roads, and ceremonial landscape (UNESCO 353).
